disambiguation: Handles EPUB import, Markdown export, and acts as a built-in EPUB reader.
extras: Desktop-only plugin for macOS and Windows. Requires external installation of pandoc.
problem: Users who want to keep their reading notes and books within a local Markdown vault but need a way to convert complex EPUB formats into editable, structured notes.
summary: Converts EPUB books into structured, chapter-based Markdown notes while maintaining assets and providing export, reading, and Kindle sending capabilities.
